name: Mask Wall Fixtures (Spray Methods)
intent: Cover outlets, switches, thermostats, and other wall-mounted fixtures before any spray application. Roll-only scenarios skip this module — overspray is the trigger, not contact paint. Heuristic of 6 fixtures per room drives the rate.
doctrine: Rate is rooms-per-hour, not fixtures-per-hour. The 4 rooms/hr figure assumes ~6 fixtures per typical residential room and ~2.5 minutes per fixture for tape + plastic. Scenarios that include this module are spray and spray_backroll only. Roll scenarios omit the module entirely.
